# NeelStack Solutions

> NeelStack Solutions Private Limited is an AI-native technology and software engineering company incorporated in Uttar Pradesh, India (CIN: U62011UP2026PTC250857). We build proprietary software products, engineer custom business applications, modernise legacy systems, and deliver specialised AI and software engineering capabilities through flexible delivery teams.

## 1. Proprietary Software Products

- [DhruvaOS](https://neelstack.com/products/dhruvaos): Flagship AI-powered School Operating System (School ERP / EdOS). Unifying admissions, fee reconciliation, RFID/biometric campus attendance, examination suites, and multi-tenant school governance. Beta live with early institutional pilots; full production launch November 14, 2026 (https://dhruvaos.com).
- [ToolVines](https://neelstack.com/products/toolvines): High-performance browser-native developer utilities, cryptography formatters, and PDF engines executing 100% client-side via Rust WebAssembly with zero remote document storage (https://toolvines.com).

## 2. Enterprise Software & AI Engineering Services

- [Custom Software Development](https://neelstack.com/services/custom-software): Bespoke business software, schema-isolated multi-tenant ERP platforms, internal workflow engines, and secure API systems.
- [AI Application & Agent Development](https://neelstack.com/services/ai-development): Custom multi-agent systems (LangGraph, LangChain), domain knowledge RAG pipelines, cognitive search, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) tool integration.
- [Legacy System Modernization](https://neelstack.com/services/legacy-modernisation): Deconstructing monolithic codebases into scalable microservices and APIs using strangler-fig patterns, dual-write synchronization, and automated regression safeguards.
- [Cloud Architecture & DevOps](https://neelstack.com/services/devops-cloud): Multi-AZ Kubernetes orchestration, automated CI/CD pipelines, containerization, and cloud infrastructure optimization.
- [Modern Web Applications](https://neelstack.com/services/web-applications): High-performance Next.js 16 web applications, sub-second API backends, and responsive SaaS dashboards.
- [Mobile App Development](https://neelstack.com/services/mobile-development): Cross-platform iOS and Android mobile solutions with offline synchronization (React Native, Flutter).

## 3. Specialist Engineering & AI Workforce

- [Contract Software Engineering](https://neelstack.com/services/contract-engineering): Senior contract software developers across TypeScript/Next.js, Python FastAPI, Java, and Cloud DevOps for flexible staff augmentation.
- [Dedicated Engineering Pods](https://neelstack.com/services/dedicated-teams): Managed cross-functional engineering teams (3–8 specialists) governed by agile sprint retainers with 100% client code ownership.
- [AI Model Evaluation](https://neelstack.com/services/ai-model-evaluation): Human-in-the-loop (HITL) evaluation, RLHF preference ranking, prompt-response accuracy benchmarking, and model output validation.
- [AI Data Annotation & Operations](https://neelstack.com/services/ai-data-annotation): Domain-specific data collection, multilingual Indian vernacular validation, code review benchmarking, and managed QA pipelines.
- [Vendor Partnerships](https://neelstack.com/partnerships): Technology subcontracting, delivery partnerships, and vendor onboarding for IT service integrators and enterprise software firms.
